_about: Words for the Guild Calendar (/calendar/). Claude's drafts in the Guild voice, for Ryan to rewrite. Dates and sky events are calculated in src/sky.js; this file only holds the words. Holidays: 'when' is either a fixed month/day or a season turn (march, june, september, december). The wheel of the year here turns for the Northern Hemisphere.

holidays.name: Imbolc
holidays.line: The first stirring under the snow.
holidays.text: Deep in winter, something wakes. Imbolc is the Guild's promise that the dark is already loosening its grip: the ewes are milking, the seeds are dreaming, and every hearth that stayed lit through the long nights deserves a toast.
celebrate: Light a candle for something you're ready to begin
Sweep out a corner and make room
Write a wish on paper and tuck it under a stone

holidays.name: Ostara
holidays.line: Day and night stand even, and the light wins by a whisker.
holidays.text: At Ostara the scales sit level for one bright moment, and then the days begin to win. It's a festival of fresh starts and fair shares: planting what you mean to grow, and remembering that balance is something we tend, not something we're handed.
celebrate: Plant seeds, real or otherwise
Paint eggs with someone younger than you
Trade something you have too much of

holidays.name: Beltane
holidays.line: Ribbons, bonfires, and everything in bloom.
holidays.text: Beltane is the year in full flower: bonfires on the hill, ribbons around the maypole, and the whole village dancing because it can. The Guild keeps it as a feast of joy for its own sake, of love in every form, and of growing things given room to grow.
celebrate: Leave flowers on a neighbor's doorstep
Dance somewhere you'd usually only walk
Jump a small fire (or a candle) for luck

holidays.name: Litha
holidays.line: The longest day, and the sun at the top of its arc.
holidays.text: At Litha the sun climbs as high as it ever will and lingers there, and the village stays up to keep it company. It's a celebration of power used warmly: the light that ripens, the strength that shares, and the long golden evenings when nobody wants to go home.
celebrate: Watch the sun rise or set on purpose
Eat outside with people you love
Share something you've grown, made or learned

holidays.name: Lughnasadh
holidays.line: The first loaf, and games in the stubble fields.
holidays.text: Lughnasadh honors the first harvest and the hands that brought it in. The old tellings say the bright god Lugh held games for his foster mother; the Guild keeps the spirit with feasts, friendly contests and bread broken together, because work shared becomes play.
celebrate: Bake bread, or buy a loaf and share it
Hold a silly contest with friends
Thank someone whose work feeds you

holidays.name: Mabon
holidays.line: The scales level again; the cellar fills.
holidays.text: At Mabon day and night balance once more, and this time the dark begins to lead. It's the Guild's thanksgiving: counting what the year has given, putting some by for the cold, and making sure everyone at the table has enough.
celebrate: Write down three things the year gave you
Give away something you no longer need
Cook with what's in season

holidays.name: Samhain
holidays.line: The veil grows thin, and the masks come out.
holidays.text: Samhain closes the old year and opens the dark half of the wheel. The veil between worlds grows thin, so the Guild sets an extra place for those we miss, tells their stories, and puts on masks that let us play at being someone braver. What ends here becomes the soil for what's next.
celebrate: Tell a story about someone you miss
Wear a mask and be bolder than usual
Carve a lantern to light a neighbor's way

holidays.name: Guy Fox Day
holidays.line: Remember, remember the fox of November.
holidays.text: Old Britain lit bonfires on the fifth of November; the Guild lights them for Reynard. Guy Fox Day celebrates the clever, kind kind of trouble: the mischief that makes overlords sweat and neighbors laugh. Masks on, lanterns high, and a toast to every fox who ever outfoxed a crown.
celebrate: Gather friends around a fire or a candle and swap stories
Do one small, harmless bit of mischief for good
Wear a fox mask and say something true out loud

holidays.name: Yule
holidays.line: The longest night, and the light's return.
holidays.text: Yule is the year's longest night, and the Guild keeps it like a vigil: lanterns lit, stories told, and everyone gathered close until the sun comes back. From here the days only grow. It's a feast of hope, warmth and generosity, kept by anyone who has ever waited for morning.
celebrate: Keep a candle lit through the evening
Give a gift without signing it
Stay up late with people who make the dark feel small

phases.name: New Moon
phases.line: A dark sky and a clean slate. Plant an intention and let it rest in the soil.

phases.name: Waxing Crescent
phases.line: A sliver of silver. Small first steps, taken while nobody's watching.

phases.name: First Quarter
phases.line: Half lit and climbing. Decisions, effort, and pushing past the first snag.

phases.name: Waxing Gibbous
phases.line: Almost there. Refine, adjust, and keep tending what you started.

phases.name: Full Moon
phases.line: The mirror at its brightest. See what has grown, celebrate it, and share the light.

phases.name: Waning Gibbous
phases.line: The light pours outward. A season for gratitude and for passing on what you've learned.

phases.name: Last Quarter
phases.line: Half lit and letting go. Clear out what no longer serves the Guild in you.

phases.name: Waning Crescent
phases.line: A last thin smile. Rest, reflect, and get ready to begin again.

full_moons.blue_line: A second full moon in one month. Once in a blue moon is now.

signs.name: Aries
signs.title: The Spark
signs.text: Aries charges in first, lute already playing. Bold, honest and quick to defend the underdog, Aries is the courage that gets the whole Guild moving.
signs.edge: Learning that a pause can be a power move.
signs.moon: With the moon in Aries, feelings run hot and quick. A good day to start something brave.

signs.name: Taurus
signs.title: The Gardener
signs.text: Taurus plants, tends and waits, and the harvest always comes. Loyal, sensual and steady as old roots, Taurus reminds the Guild that good things grow at their own pace.
signs.moon: With the moon in Taurus, comfort calls. Savor good food, soft blankets and slow work.

signs.name: Gemini
signs.title: The Messenger
signs.text: Gemini carries a quill in each hand and a question in every pocket. Curious, witty and endlessly connecting, Gemini spreads the Guild's word faster than the LEOs can tear down the posters.
signs.edge: Finishing one story before starting the next.
signs.moon: With the moon in Gemini, minds buzz. Talk, trade notes and follow your curiosity.

signs.name: Cancer
signs.title: The Keeper of the Hearth
signs.text: Cancer builds the shelter and keeps the soup warm. Tender on the inside and fierce about family, found or otherwise, Cancer makes sure the Guild always has a home to come back to.
signs.edge: Letting others care for you, too.
signs.moon: With the moon in Cancer, feelings run close to home. Nest, nurture and call someone you love.

signs.name: Leo
signs.title: The Bright Heart
signs.text: Not every lion is a LEO. The true Leo shines so others can see by the light: generous, playful and warm-hearted, a natural performer who leads by lifting the whole stage.
signs.edge: Sharing the spotlight and enjoying it.
signs.moon: With the moon in Leo, hearts want to play. Create, perform and celebrate someone.

signs.name: Virgo
signs.title: The Healer
signs.text: Virgo notices the cracked beam before it falls and fixes it without a fuss. Thoughtful, skilled and quietly devoted, Virgo is the Guild's healer, mender and keeper of good habits.
signs.moon: With the moon in Virgo, tidy hands make a calm mind. Sort, mend and care for your body.

signs.name: Libra
signs.title: The Diplomat
signs.text: Libra weighs every side and finds the trade where everyone wins. Graceful, fair and allergic to injustice, Libra is the Guild's peacemaker, and its sharpest eye for beauty.
signs.edge: Choosing, even when both sides have a point.
signs.moon: With the moon in Libra, harmony matters. Make peace, make art and make a fair deal.

signs.name: Scorpio
signs.title: The Alchemist
signs.text: Scorpio dives where others won't and comes back with treasure. Intense, loyal and unafraid of the dark, Scorpio turns endings into compost and secrets into strength.
signs.edge: Trusting before every question is answered.
signs.moon: With the moon in Scorpio, feelings run deep. Tell the truth, release what's done and trust your gut.

signs.name: Sagittarius
signs.title: The Wanderer
signs.text: Sagittarius aims an arrow at the horizon and laughs all the way there. Adventurous, honest and hungry for meaning, Sagittarius brings home stories that make the whole village's world bigger.
signs.edge: Finding the adventure in staying put, sometimes.
signs.moon: With the moon in Sagittarius, the horizon calls. Explore, learn something new and laugh loudly.

signs.name: Capricorn
signs.title: The Builder
signs.text: Capricorn knows how the LEOs' towers are built, and builds ladders instead. Patient, disciplined and quietly hilarious, Capricorn climbs the mountain and then sends a rope back down.
signs.moon: With the moon in Capricorn, plans get practical. Build, budget and take one more steady step.

signs.name: Aquarius
signs.title: The Visionary
signs.text: Aquarius pours out the water of new ideas for everyone to drink. Inventive, independent and devoted to the common good, Aquarius dreams up the Guild of tomorrow and invites everyone in.
signs.edge: Letting the heart into the big ideas.
signs.moon: With the moon in Aquarius, minds turn to the many. Gather your people and dream out loud.

signs.name: Pisces
signs.title: The Dreamer
signs.text: Pisces swims between worlds, carrying dreams from one to the other. Compassionate, imaginative and gently magical, Pisces feels what others feel and paints it into something beautiful.
signs.edge: Keeping a shore to swim back to.
signs.moon: With the moon in Pisces, the veil is thin. Dream, make art and be gentle with yourself.

earth.line: craft, resources and the work of the hands

modes.cardinal: Cardinal signs begin the seasons: they start things.
modes.fixed: Fixed signs hold the middle of the seasons: they keep things going.
modes.mutable: Mutable signs close the seasons: they adapt and carry things forward.

mercury.retrograde_line: The trickster planet seems to walk backwards. Reynard's favorite season: a time to re-read, re-connect, re-think and re-do. Back up your notes and forgive the typos.
mercury.direct_line: Mercury turns forward again. The messages flow, the plans unstick, and the quills write true.

eclipses.solar_line: The moon slips in front of the sun. A new moon with the volume turned up: a powerful moment to begin something brave.
eclipses.lunar_line: The earth's shadow brushes the full moon. A full moon with the volume turned up: see clearly, let go generously.

hemisphere: The wheel of the year turns here for the Northern Hemisphere. Times are shown in your own time zone.
